name: Ember
title: Fox Courier
description: A quick-pawed fox who carries messages between your agents.
catchphrase: A quick-pawed fox who carries messages between your agents.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Crunching sweet forest berries! Bushy orange tail swishes fast! 🍓🦊
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Yip! Shaking morning dew off fur! Trail dispatch ready! 🦊
companionPersonality.petReaction: Nuzzles your hand with cold, friendly fox nose! 🦊💖

dialogue.idle: Curled up in a neat little donut on the floorboards. 🦊
dialogue.working: Dashing across forest shortcuts to deliver subagent frames! 🦊⚡
dialogue.thinking: Ears swiveling 180 degrees to catch distant whispers... 🤔
dialogue.success: YIPPEE! Message delivered before the sender even blinked! 🦊🎉
dialogue.error: Tripped over a mossy root! Rolling back to feet with grin! 🦊
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... nose tucked under big fluffy tail... 🌙
